name: High Protein Loaded Nacho Fries
desc: Air-fried russet fries piled with lean ground beef simmered in a cheesy taco sauce made from milk, broth and Velveeta.

source.title: High Protein Loaded Nacho Fries
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 2 medium russet potatoes, cut into 1/4 inch fries
1/2 cup 2% milk (the creator uses Fairlife ultra-filtered)
1/2 cup low-sodium chicken or beef broth

steps: Preheat the air fryer to 380°F. Spray the fries with avocado oil and toss with the salt.
Air fry in a single layer, in batches, for 12 to 15 min, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
While the fries cook, brown the beef with the salt and pepper in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, until no longer pink (160°F), 6 to 8 min.
Stir in the taco seasoning, milk and broth and bring to a simmer. Tear in the Velveeta slices and simmer, stirring, until the cheese melts and the sauce thickens and coats the beef, 3 to 5 min.
Divide the fries among 3 plates and spoon the nacho beef over the top.
tips: About 458 calories and 41 g protein per serving, for 3 servings, per the creator.
The creator tops these with a yogurt ranch from his cookbook; the fries can also be baked instead of air fried.

references.title: Air Fryer French Fries
